summary: A watch's pull request facts (head, checks, review state) no longer lag up to 180 s after `st gh watch`. The watch declares the repository's standing observer, which reads issues, before the watch subscription that adds pull requests and comments. A poll that landed between the two read issues alone, and the next poll kept that poll's three-minute deadline. An observer whose requested fields widen now polls at once; admission and rate-limit deadlines still bound it. Fixes #4470.

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay; the change is in-memory scheduling.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Only when this member polls changes; members of older builds keep their cadence and read the same claims.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores the old cadence; nothing persisted changes.
